name: procurement
notes: Owns requisitions, request for quotation with quote comparison, purchase orders and goods receipts. Requisition and purchase order approval use the approval engine document types requisition and purchase_order (H-09); the module reacts to approval.* events. Each project-destined order line has at most one live committed entry in the project cost ledger (prc_po_lines.commit_entry_id): approval posts it with key po:<line>:v<revision>; a receipt posts an approved entry at the order rate for the accepted quantity and replaces the commitment by the remainder; closing, cancelling and cancelling a receipt reverse and re-post, so the ledger keeps the whole history. Store-destined orders post no project cost; inventory reacts to goods.received. Stores belong to inventory (P1-12): store_id is an opaque key until then, and the checks that stock from a receipt was issued or that a bill refers to it (BR-8) are injected as GrnGuards, which default to none. The delivery challan photo is a file of entity type prc_grn, attached in the same transaction as the receipt.
